search_text: published ZDI-25-1070 ZDI-CAN-27395 TradingView Desktop Electron Uncontrolled Search Path Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2025-12-10 CVE-2025-14498 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-14498 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['TradingView'] ['Desktop'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of TradingView Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the Electron framework. The product loads a script file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of a target user. Fixed in version 2.13.0 ( https://www.tradingview.com/support/solutions/43000673888-tradingview-desktop-releases-and-release-notes/ ) ['2025-07-18 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2025-12-10 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2025-12-10 - Advisory Updated'] Xavier DANEST https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-25-1070/
title: TradingView Desktop Electron Uncontrolled Search Path Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of TradingView Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the Electron framework. The product loads a script file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of a target user.
